draft: Draft — dates not yet confirmed by the DM.

sessions.sum: Campaign opening: the party wakes early in a warm tavern cellar in Lervik, reads a letter, finds the lakeside house of a rich family, and meets a dormant barlgura demon with a magical collar; Tats's character is taken by the guard and an elf problem-solver appears.
The party has beaten the apes at the house by the lake and has the ring; back at the bar they choose which of three guild swarms (thieves' guild leaders Jorni, Askot, Thavyra) to follow.

sessions.hint: ca. 5 Tage Reise nach Dalior
sessions.sum: Short session: the party travels in padded wagons towards Dalior (about 5 days, through a flowery forest in the northwest) with the drivers Calboretta and Crank, and the wagon convoy is ambushed.

sessions.hint: 1-2 Tage nach Überfall
sessions.sum: The party loots the caravan, keeps one wagon and an albino pig, camps one night with watches (two moons visible), crosses the foothills of Otronus and arrives in Dalior, where they find a tavern, the Bodenloser Krug and the night market.
Very short notes (the player was sick): at the slave market the party buys Tats's character; a quest about a beheaded bronze statue points to 'College-Boys' as culprits.

sessions.hint: Tag 0 (erste Nacht Feuer) bis Abend Tag 1
sessions.sum: The party has the decapitated copper statue quest, meets the culprits (students), is woken at night by a burning slum district, is guided by Melissa and Aubonne through an underground exhaustion zone, breaks open the barricade, hides in the magic shop, rests, gets paid by the city and kills rat-monsters in the Rakshasa Tempel bar.

sessions.hint: ca. 3-4 Tage nach dem Feuer (Schätzung)
sessions.sum: Quest board (d100 jobs), El Loco skeleton investigation, a night's rest, Mason's offer (clear his cellar of undead for 40 gold per room), pickup of the Infinity Bag, Aubonne's celebration, naming of the Gold Daggers, drinks in the Rakshasa Tempel.

sessions.hint: Tag 1 im Mason-Keller
sessions.since: unknown (shopping trip was planned; '2 Tage' sign)
sessions.sum: The party goes up to Mason's mansion and starts clearing the cellar: severed hands (Jacques the cook-hand is kept), gnoll-witherlings, a hand-boss, a nurse zombie, a rope-and-lever bridge room with skeletons, caged zombies, and a pool room with a frog-anglerfish creature.

sessions.hint: Tag 1 im Mason-Keller (Fortsetzung)
sessions.sum: Continuing in Mason's cellar: Coda joins, the suicide-pact statue puzzle (Judeus) is solved by Leumas, zombie animals are killed, and the hall of hundreds of undead is seen from balconies with loot (scroll, beets, unfinished mechanism).

sessions.hint: Tag 2 oder 3 im Mason-Keller
sessions.sum: The cellar clearing continues: spike/eye room, the pool monster, swarm room, library with poltergeists, long rest, undead-dragon scream, servants' dining room, zombie rogue, then prisoners are found in cages; Lady Tyburn, Brentan and Sixt are freed, Galatea (sister of Melissa and Aubonne) is rescued, and behind a huge door an undead dragon (CR 14) waits.
Protocol lost. The party won the fight and got paid.

sessions.hint: Tag A Mittag bis Tag B Nacht (Dinner in 4 Tagen)
sessions.since: unknown (session 11 missing; dragon fight and 740 gold not on record)
sessions.sum: After the (unrecorded) end of the Mason job, the party visits Felix, splits gold, goes to library, smithy, garden shop and the Rakshasa Tempel; a birth/death banner mystery and the Entertainment District guard raid; next day the party gets Yorni's call and a job at the Rosenpalast about the Zhurek murder, with a dinner in 4 days.

sessions.hint: 3 Tage bis zum Dinner (countdown) - day after session 12 day B if S12 said 'in 4 days'
sessions.since: +1 day (S12: dinner in 4 days on day B; S13: 3 days left)
sessions.sum: A full day in Dalior: smithy, descent to the underground fight club and Herviar, dive bar with Dave and Gladis, tailor Arachne, casino, temple bar, Aubonne and the dwarves; the next morning Leumas has vanished.

sessions.hint: ca. 14 Tage vor der Herbst-Wende; Dinner 'in vier Tagen'
sessions.sum: Leumas is abducted in the night; the party learns about the mass disappearances, witnesses the Entertainment District declare war, rides dire tigers north with Shelly, wins orc allies and storms the camp holding the prisoners, freeing hostages and Leumas.

sessions.season: Spätsommer (ca. 2 Wochen vor der Herbst-Wende, minus days elapsed)
sessions.hint: some days after S14 (dinner 'in 4 days' stated in S14)
sessions.sum: The party returns with the freed prisoners on tigers, smuggles them into Dalior disguised as slave traders, fights Rosengarden guards at the Entertainment District gate, meets Exandria von Amare, learns of Barzan's wanted poster and spends the night in a luxury hotel.

sessions.hint: unknown
sessions.sum: Only a short bullet recap survives: Leumas's life-threatening surgery, an assassination plan on the Diplomacy Minister, the Ophris-Moria war, tension in the city, Felix still missing, a school visit and the party stopping in the library.

sessions.hint: day 0 = library day; prison storm 'in 5-6 Tagen' (stated on day 0 evening)
sessions.sum: As exchange students the party visits the library, sees two giants cause damage, watches the Entertainment District wall up its gates, learns the prison entrance and a 5-6 day storm schedule, dreams of a fox and the forgotten war, and the next morning fights a Blackguard and two ogres while Robin calls for help.

sessions.hint: day 1 (S17 morning of chiefs' meeting) - continues; prison storm planned 5-6 days after S17 day 0
sessions.sum: The party rushes to Robin's shop, kills the guards, rescues Robin and two friends from a failed Tiny Hut, hides them in the temple, renames them, searches the fox house, and learns Melissa is outside the city and Yorni wants to kill the foreign minister.

sessions.hint: day 3 of the S17-S20 chain (see offsets); prison storm announced 5-6 days after S17 day 0
sessions.sum: The party hands Robin to Aubonne, brokers an alliance between the dwarves (Embrach), the MEHR and the ED, buys supplies and weapons, moves into a mint-green house, and the next day BB is teleported away by a floating card.

sessions.hint: same day as S19 end (day 3 of chain), evening
sessions.sum: BB's card teleport journey is resolved, the group learns to teleport with the tarot cards, shops for fireworks and black powder, then darkens part of the district for an hour by shooting light plants while fireworks show the Gold Daggers symbol and a street festival erupts.

sessions.hint: 3 days to break-in; 7 days to festival (countdown on day 0 of S21)
sessions.sum: With three days left to the prison break-in and seven to the festival assassination, the party prepares in the district, receives Herviar's underground map, then on break-in day enters Oubliette, wins two fights, finds the logbook and steps through the middle teleport circle into hydra territory.

sessions.hint: break-in day (P) + 1; festival in about 3-4 days
sessions.sum: Inside the Oubliette wilderness the party kills two hydras, hides from barlgura apes, meets prisoners (Odem, Rom, Mogak, Special, Sturm and the Last Victim), frees many, and returns to the temple by tarot card with a handful of ex-prisoners to prepare a mass evacuation by ladder.

sessions.hint: festival 'in drei Tagen' (countdown on S23 day 0)
sessions.sum: The party releases the ~700 prisoners using a 200 m ladder while the ED storms its second gate; the mob attacks the rich plates, the party loots, reunites at the Entertainment District, and Dr. Mason appears at the door.

sessions.hint: Mason: 'next three days' without chaos; festival still ahead
sessions.sum: Dr. Mason appears, kills and releases Lorilla, and warns against chaos; Koda is healed at Felix's after Melissa's death is revealed; a gelatinous cube kills and revives Leumas and BB; the party buys diamonds, plans the assassination and receives the amulet pattern.

sessions.hint: Stadtfest startet in 2 Tagen; Parade am 2. Festtag

place.t: Dalior, then forest and kobold village

sessions.sum: In Dalior the party sells jewelry, delivers Aubonne's logbook, collects diamonds, confirms the assassination with Yorni and buys a wagon; at the autumn festival parade Eloryn kills the minister, the party flees and learns Yorni betrayed them, then travels to the kobold village.

sessions.hint: 2 days (arrival day and the following day)

place.t: Kobolddorf (Kobold village in the western mountains)

sessions.sum: Two days in the kobold village: meeting Gax and Geppo, discovering a sealed tunnel with a telepathic voice, Eloryn's backstory, and the descent into an underwater cave where the party kills an Aboleth.

sessions.hint: continues the same day as the Aboleth fight, then 1 more day
sessions.sum: After the Aboleth fight the party finds a rift to the Water Plane, reunites in the village, is visited by the smoke figure 'Das letzte Opfer' who binds a ring to Snix, then kills a minotaur and attends the kobold funeral.

sessions.hint: about 3-4 days of travel from the kobold village to the monastery feast

place.t: From the kobold village over the border to the Ophris monastery

sessions.sum: The party leaves the kobold village, crosses a bridge and the border into Ophris, survives an assassin at a ruin, discovers Ophris bounties on them and arrives at the monastery for the autumn-start feast.

sessions.hint: feast night plus the following day (night of feast = day F, trial = day F+1)
sessions.sum: The party feasts and drinks with old dwarf friends, meets Fred the pacifist orc, is questioned and warned by Abbot Don Hor and passes the opening tests for the forgotten-temple mission.

sessions.hint: evening after the test and the following morning/midday
sessions.sum: After the test the abbot softens, the mission to the Forgotten Temple is briefed, the party receives magic items from the laboratory and sees Fred leave because of an impending goliath civil war.

sessions.hint: afternoon plus 2 travel days
sessions.sum: A day of research and preparation at the monastery, then a two-day storm climb to the Forgotten Temple, ending with a blue dragon that links Koda's stone to Mason.

sessions.hint: summit night, next day, then memory scene
sessions.sum: The party opens the Forgotten Temple with the kryptex, receives two god rings, fights the blue dragon Akaresh, and in the temple's memory-hall witnesses the birth of the child Ophris.

sessions.hint: 4.5 weeks in the temple at the midpoint; ~1.5 weeks passed at the start
sessions.since: time jump inside temple: ca. +1.5 weeks at wake-up
sessions.sum: Inside the temple the party sees four memories of the child Ophris, Zima and Aria, Felix's war and the sacrifice that created the mountain, learns Mason studies the same event, then kills the dragon and loots its hoard.

sessions.hint: mid to late December (stated), almost 2.5 months after entering the temple

place.t: Vor dem Tempel, Kloster, then Ophris capital

sessions.sum: After killing the dragon the party eats it, Eloryn loses Blobbert and her warlock powers, they fly to the monastery in mid/late December for updates and a patron search, then travel to the Ophris capital.

sessions.hint: 2 days in the Ophris capital (days 1 and 2 after the shopping day)
sessions.since: same day (continues in the magic shop)
sessions.sum: Two winter days in the Ophris capital: shopping, Glargrit's smithy, library research, forging Koda's dragon-horn hammer and a pub quiz that ends with vigilantes questioning the party.

sessions.hint: day 3 in the Ophris capital, plus the following night/morning
sessions.sum: A full day in the Ophris capital: the hammer is named Akareth, a palace invitation fails, dinner at the Schwan, a fight-club double fight is won, Eloryn signs a pact with Chetzi in a dream and Radvian relays the king's invitation.

sessions.hint: Day 1 of two days in Ophris (audience with the king evening of day 1; day 2 = 'Letzter Tag in der Hauptstadt')

place.t: Ophris (Eiserner Kopf, Bar Tonne, Schwan Blanc, then the safehouse Die Villa)

sessions.sum: In Ophris the party spends a day at the spa and meets King Azan Aeducan in the cellar of the Bar Tonne, who gives them seven emblems, a safehouse with a teleport circle and the mission to terrorise the gangs of Aarum as internationally wanted 'terrorists'. After a day of shopping (a stolen Scroll of the Comet from Hilde) they teleport to the Villa.

sessions.season: Winter-like (snow-covered mountains at start); mud and rain en route; 'fast Vollmond' on travel night 7
sessions.hint: Safehouse day 0, then travel days 1-9

place.t: Safehouse in the mountains, then travel by eagle/wagon toward the coast

sessions.sum: In the snowy safehouse the party links the green dragonborn's charred arm to the drug Zunder, finds a panic room and flies off on giant eagles. Over nine travel days they meet a yeti-hunter, trade diamonds and metals in a kobold village, buy horses and a wagon in Tulip, and are repeatedly attacked by the green dragonborn and the last victim, reaching a port town on day 9.

sessions.hint: Ferry boarding at 2 pm on travel day 9 (continuing session 38); arrival in Aarum the following day

place.t: Ferry ('der Fisch') to Aarum, then Aarum

sessions.sum: The party boards the ferry to Aarum, is harassed overnight by the last victim, and befriends the Winter-god follower Sarmulin. They arrive in the underground industrial city, register under false names, scout the districts and sell raw metal to the foundress Dabri of the Torren district, receiving a sending stone.

sessions.title: Deals like Daggers
sessions.hint: Aarum day 1 evening (settlement at the foundry) through Aarum day 3 morning (shopping); the text says 'wie gestern' for the piazza on the second day

place.t: Aarum (Giesserei, Piazza, restaurant 'Die gleichstehenden Monde', Volkam's brewery, Tower district)

sessions.sum: The party splits the profit from the ithrium and mithril sale, sells the rest on the piazza, dines in a restaurant recommended by Dabri, meets Torren by scrying call and then raids Volkam and Partner's brewery, killing Fellbrün Volkam and taking over his golem Jacques. They then enter the Tower district and a magic shop.

sessions.title: Deals like Daggers
sessions.hint: Aarum day 3 (shopping, Tower, dinner and theatre with Torren, night fight with dragonborn) into Aarum day 4 morning (attack on Madame Dimdell)

place.t: Aarum (magic shop, Giesserei, brewery, Tower, Piazza, entertainment district)

sessions.sum: The party finishes shopping, changes the golem's contract, hires Kafran and Susra, visits the Tower (Nasri and Dakun), dines with Torren, and fights the green dragonborn on a balcony. They contact the summer goddess, then next morning ambush and kill Madame Dimdell in the entertainment district.

sessions.hint: Day 0 = clearing Madame Dimdell's pocket dimension (continuing from the Dimdell fight); then a timeskip of about five weeks in Aarum

place.t: Madame Dimdell's Pocket Dimension, Tower, brewery, Aarum

sessions.sum: The party enters the pocket dimension behind the pleasure district, frees roughly 120 trapped sex workers, kills a Dyre Troll and finds Dimdell's and Dr. Mason's notes on Cithrul. They broker a deal between the Tower and Torren, cure BB, and then live through about five weeks of timeskip: a first rain, letters, beer tasting and the arrival of the king's liaison, ending with news that the Tritons have joined the war on Nolia's side.

sessions.hint: Some time after week 5 of the Aarum timeskip (session 42); day of Snix's date, then a two-day trip to Krüsam and the Triton front
sessions.since: unspecified, at least a few days after week 5

place.t: Aarum, then Krüsam and the Triton front

sessions.sum: The party prepares Snix's date, during which the green dragonborn is finally named Yazi. They hire the strongest bruiser as brewery worker, buy a wagon, then teleport to Krüsam, ride to the front and infiltrate a Triton camp, kill a major, learn that Triton troops are controlled by Dominate Person stones and that Eloryn is considered a traitor, and return to Aarum.

sessions.title: All about different kind of souls
sessions.hint: Two days in Aarum: day 1 (bar, Tower, library, Torren's private meeting, night) and day 2 (government meeting at the pier); departure from Aarum planned for the day after

place.t: Aarum (bar, Tower, library, the Bubble/pocket-dimension area, pier)

sessions.sum: In Aarum the party tries to sell Volkham's Maze, accidentally binds Koda to the dragon Akareth through a pact after Nasri's tarot tattoo triggers a storm, researches souls, the cards and Leumas's changeling nature, and is warned by Torren that bounty hunters have arrived. They attend the government meeting disguised, where a Tower, Torren and state deal is concluded, and decide to leave for the south.

sessions.hint: Day 0 in a village near Peoryn, day 1 ride to Peoryn and first underwater leg, day 2 and night 2 underwater, base 1 on day 3
sessions.since: some days after the Aarum departure (not stated)

place.t: Village near Peoryn, then underwater route to Helikonos

sessions.sum: In a village near Peoryn the party scries the last victim, Mason and Yorni; Barzan nearly dies and is forced to choose a goddess (he picks the summer goddess but cannot cast). Yazi leaves for Skjall. After Peoryn the party travels underwater, meets fleeing Triton teachers twice, sees Helikonos for the first time and reaches the first base after defeating a sand robot.

sessions.hint: One day and night in Helikonos: short rest outside the city, entry, shopping, safe block, evening club, night in the water plane
sessions.sum: The party enters Helikonos in disguise, finds a safe block, learns about the Triton monarchy and the Nolian human workers digging into the crab, and goes clubbing. Leumas is abducted by a hostile figure ('Babo 1') who knows Jorni and Dr. Mason, and ends up stuck in the rock above the water-plane rift.

sessions.hint: Night of session 46 (Barzan still on the drug) into the following day; Jorni announces the public execution for 'tomorrow noon', tied to his wedding
sessions.since: same night, a few hours later (Barzan still tripping)

place.t: Helikonos: military camp near the Abyss, safe block, Temple in the entertainment district, Nolia basement

sessions.sum: The party assaults the Nolian military camp to find Leumas; Snix, BB, Koda and Lorilla are captured and brought to Jorni's office, where he announces their public execution as a wedding gift. Meanwhile Leumas climbs out of the trench; BB teleports the prisoners to the temple of the entertainment-district refugees, the party reunites with Felix and Robin, BB receives The World card, and they plan how to stop the wedding.

sessions.title: Die Hochzeit
sessions.hint: Evening/night before the wedding (planning, reconnaissance), then the wedding day itself (execution date 'morgen mittag' from session 47)

place.t: Temple cellar (entertainment district), then Jorni's palace in Nolia ('Gnolia')

sessions.sum: In the temple cellar the party plans to ruin the wedding. Lorilla scouts the palace as a fly and hawk (geese, hydra Alois, tower prison, Jorni's office), Koda meets Torren who offers help, and the party infiltrates in disguise. Yorni catches Eloryn and Leumas in the bride's tower; Snix and BB take the four swords from a hidden chapel with a pit fiend, which the wedding elite kills. Eloryn sends a firework message and Jorni broadcasts that the Gold Daggers are terrorists.

sessions.title: Crime against the currency (The Heist)
sessions.hint: Heist day and early evening of the same day; Jorni's wedding festivities ongoing
sessions.since: unknown gap; heist starts the morning after the planning day
sessions.sum: The party plans and executes a heist on Pira Devei's Zentralbank with Silk's crew, frees the goddess Nyx from a vault, loots Mason-related documents, crowns and scrolls, kills Pira, and by early evening crashes Jorni's wedding speech with a message.

sessions.title: 20'000 Leagues
sessions.hint: Morning after the heist; then about 1.5 days of downtime and sailing

place.t: Peoryn → Lerchen → at sea toward Helykonos

sessions.sum: The party studies the loot and Mason's book in rainy Peoryn, travels to the port Lerchen to meet the Bro-clan shipyard family, spends a day of downtime, goes fishing, and is attacked by tritons at night, winning a ship of their own.

sessions.title: Book of Yavin
sessions.hint: Directly after the tritons' night attack of session 50; one long day inside the Nautiloid and the Waterplane, ending in a hideout
sessions.sum: The party claims the Nautiloid (Loid), gives Koda a Returning tattoo, is pulled into the Waterplane where they sink Shen's fleet, free the fish and rest in a hideout holding two tritons prisoner.

sessions.title: Book of R'Lyeh
sessions.hint: Several days: 1-2 days sailing and harbour, 1 night aboard, then 2 days at Helikonos (day of trench/revolutionaries, day of skull raid), loot on 13.5

place.t: Hideout → harbour → trench and city of Helykonos

sessions.sum: The party executes their prisoners, repairs and remodels Loid at the harbour, closes the trench rift, allies with the Helikonos revolutionaries, destroys the stone-making skull and kills a kraken, and loots a gold-filled tomb with the Book of Azatoth.

sessions.title: Book of Azatoth
sessions.hint: About 4-5 days: 1 day in city, 2 long rests, ~2 days travel, then the forest ordeal
sessions.sum: After the skull raid the party researches riddles that lead to the equatorial gorge, rests, travels there, survives a mind-bending forest and an eye, and destroys a hidden portal.

sessions.title: Under the water, just killed Watergod
sessions.hint: About 2 days: recovery and shopping trip to Ophris on day 1, return and kobold lair on day 2

place.t: Aboard Loid near equator → Ophris → kobold lair near Helikonos

sessions.sum: After the portal fight the Summer Goddess creates a refuge room; the party shops for 486,000 gp in Ophris, meets Barzan's cousin Tarzan and Don Hor, then visits the kobolds' lair, receives a remove-curse card from Abla and kills an aboleth.

sessions.title: Punching up
sessions.hint: About 3 days: Eloryn's report and the Ruger fight on day 1, interrogation and city visit on day 2, evacuation on day 3
sessions.sum: Eloryn reports a civil war in Helikonos; the party bombs the Nolian camp, kills Arthur Ruger, learns the crab is 60% finished and Shen has about a month, and evacuates refugees and craftsmen to Bromir's shipyard.

sessions.title: Teen Robin, Felix Shenanigns
sessions.hint: About 6 days: 1 day in Helikonos / Entertainment District, 4 days travel to Aarum, day in Aarum
sessions.sum: Barzan and BB visit the Entertainment District, see Silk's evacuation plans and Felix's godlike essence, bring Robin and Treth's father back, learn from Natok about Skjall and fly to Aarum for supplies and brewery checks.

sessions.title: Catching Up
sessions.hint: About 9-10 days: 1-2 days in Aarum, then 1 week to the monastery
sessions.since: same stay / same day (intro at Felix is a recap of session 56's day)
sessions.sum: The intro replays Koda, Snix and Eloryn touching Felix; in Aarum the party calms a baby dragon tortoise, dines with Torren, sees a Wild Hunt vision, and after a week reaches the mountain monastery before heading to Skjall.

sessions.title: First day in the yard
sessions.season: cold (-25 degrees outside the wall; no season named)
sessions.hint: Arrival day, evening, night, next morning missing the 8 o'clock appointment
sessions.since: a few days after the monastery (estimated)
sessions.sum: Loid flies north to the steel wall Skjall; the party meets the king Maradak and the four factions, spends a day and night with spies, crypts and the Faceless King's nightly monster form, and oversleeps its audience.

sessions.title: Delusions of a savior
sessions.hint: Day 2 in Skjall: from about 10-11 am to the late evening throne-room fight
sessions.since: same morning (after the missed 8 o'clock appointment)
sessions.sum: On the second day in Skjall the party learns from Leumas that the king is the monster, shops and researches in the libraries, views the Wild Hunt from the wall, confronts the king and fights waves of Wild Hunt monsters until a winged figure appears.

sessions.title: Exhaustion
sessions.hint: Night after the throne-room fight of session 59, then the next morning
sessions.sum: The throne-room fight continues until the party kills a winged monster and sees the Grave King, then returns to Loid to expose a doppelganger, fights exhaustion through the night, learns via Legend Lore that the wall's power is stored in the throne, and joins the king's battle where Snix acts strangely.

sessions.title: Change
sessions.hint: Friday = 'fightiest day' (day-of-week named in text); no countdown
sessions.sum: Party investigates how to activate the Wall, learns from Goliath records about King Vorad, Barzan dies and is brought back via Lady Ty's wish, then they hunt a shape-shifter and end up in a fight with a monster.

sessions.title: Escalating
sessions.hint: night after session 61; 'für morgen' leaders meeting planned
sessions.sum: Barzan recounts dying; the party survives the monster, gets a long rest via Divine Intervention, kills 'the Mother', finds Lorilla and Koda missing, and brings the corpse to the king.

sessions.title: The Veil
sessions.hint: 'hött esch rodeo' (today); Leumas tells Sadam to return 'am mäntig'
sessions.sum: Sadam joins, the party removes parasites, opens the obelisk door, enters Limbo (the Veil), kills a giant, helps Karoth, meditates to free six runes and finds the Ophris child among inscribed armours.

sessions.title: Nightmare Overseer
sessions.hint: Schneesturm in Limbo; party in bed at 3 am; king announcement 'morn'
sessions.sum: The party escapes a haunted limbo tavern, returns, then defeats the Nightmare Overseer in a second dream-tavern and learns of the tavern's logbook; Sadam is lost to the Wild Hunt.

sessions.title: Braiding Strings
sessions.season: Winter (unnatural; snow caused by the Winter Goddess)
sessions.hint: 'Wir sind aktuell im 830'; Mason expected in a few days; 'es esch wenter'
sessions.sum: Dream-talk with Lotti reveals logbook dates; on waking, snow falls on Skjall, the party catches the spy Vokon (renamed Beat), warns the king of Mason's coming arrival, and Eloryn bolts for the Wild Hunt.

sessions.season: Winter (unnatural; snow caused by the Winter Goddess)
sessions.hint: 1-2 days until Mason's arrival (countdown given in text)

place.t: Haus im Goliath viertel; Limbo; ship in Skjall

sessions.sum: Lorilla returns from the Wild Hunt, the party learns Eloryn is there, then they offer goulash to the Winter Goddess in Limbo, survive a chaotic fight and celebrate with the king and allies.

sessions.season: Winter (unnatural; snow caused by the Winter Goddess)
sessions.hint: Mason approaching; Forbiddance lasts 16 hours
sessions.sum: After a feast, Leumas romances Kuruki; an earthquake and Limbo breach hit Skjall, the moon bleeds, and the party subdues Eloryn (cursed) and seals the hole in the Wall with Forbiddance.

sessions.title: Breach
sessions.season: Winter (unnatural; snow caused by the Winter Goddess)
sessions.hint: Mason arriving ('wechtig und schnell'); Snix's dream: 'e 1-3 stund oder so doo' in Limbo forest

place.t: Dreamhouse im Ork-Viertel; Skjall throne hall; Meat Shredder

sessions.sum: The party kills a giant lynx, deals with planar breaches, regroups with the king on priorities, contacts Mason and Felix by Sending, and plans to lure the undead army to the Meat Shredder.

sessions.title: Objectives
sessions.season: Winter (unnatural; snow caused by the Winter Goddess)
sessions.hint: Battle day: Mason arrives; Mason's Legendary Resistance '6x pro tag'
sessions.sum: Yorni returns Koda; Leumas lures the undead horde; Mason and Felix arrive and everything collapses around the Monument; BB's soul seems lost.

sessions.title: Protokoll: BB
sessions.season: Winter (unnatural; snow caused by the Winter Goddess)
sessions.hint: after Mason's arrival; one long rest during the session
sessions.sum: BB wakes as Wanda; four party members drop into the pit, reach Lotti's house, build the tavern, learn of space elves and fight through burning wild magic to Yorni's fortification.

sessions.title: Protokoll: BB, Leumas
sessions.season: Winter (unnatural; snow caused by the Winter Goddess)
sessions.hint: Yorni: 'a month or so'; 'hött oder morn' objectives not complete; one long rest
sessions.sum: After regrouping, the party learns Mason's three objectives from Yorni, kills the druid Tordram (rat), frees the Winter Goddess from nails and joins the army's spearhead.

sessions.title: Protokoll: BB, Leumas
sessions.season: Winter (unnatural; snow caused by the Winter Goddess)
sessions.hint: tavern logbook: 'Im Jahre 842'
sessions.sum: The party hides in the Wall, identifies cursed bracelets, finds a hidden tavern where Eloryn's aunt Muryn and elves live in an earlier time, and obtains a teleportation circle to the Red City.

sessions.title: Protokoll: BB, Leumas
sessions.season: Winter (unnatural, Winter Goddess; stated from s65)
sessions.hint: Same visit in the time-displaced tavern; no new date given
sessions.sum: The party copies Lotti's logbook as a fake with 18 forged pages, a wild-magic fireball hits the tavern, and the elves ask for two items in exchange for the real book. Outside in the sewers they find a gift box with a cake that leaves Snix obsessed.

sessions.title: Protokoll: BB, Leumas
sessions.season: Winter (unnatural, Winter Goddess; stated from s65)
sessions.hint: One day and night in Skjall and its sewers; ends with a long rest
sessions.since: continuous (same stretch after leaving the tavern)

place.t: Skjall (throne room, Goliath quarter) and the sewers

sessions.sum: Snix's cake hunt leads through the throne room into the medical tent, where the disguised Yaenne drugs and abducts him. After rescuing him the party parleys with Yaenne in the sewers, fights gas-potato monsters together, a blue dragon hatches, and Barzan's sending finds Zima drunk in the Red City before a long rest.

sessions.season: Winter (unnatural, Winter Goddess; stated from s65)
sessions.hint: Morning after the long rest through to the night after the king's death

place.t: Skjall (Goliath quarter, throne room, Orc quarter, Minotaur quarter, the Wall)

sessions.sum: After finishing the long rest the party enters the changed throne hall, Snix and Lorilla steal a huge diamond during the archwizard battle, and the group breaks the Wall open with molotovs to fight a tentacled monster. The dying king Thor asks Leumas to kill him; Leumas does so and Lorilla flies him and the corpse away.

sessions.title: The Death of the King and the Rise of New One!
sessions.season: Winter (unnatural, Winter Goddess; stated from s65)
sessions.hint: Evening/night after the king's death through the fight in the mushroom plane

place.t: Skjall throne room, the Monument, the mushroom realm

sessions.sum: Leumas announces the king's death to the people of Skjall and takes over the crown, the party examines the cube and the Monument (Leumas gets armour), then enters the mushroom realm through a die-riddle door. There they fight Das letzte Opfer for seven rounds until it is at 33 HP; meanwhile BB meets the first queen of Skjall.

sessions.title: Results
sessions.season: Winter (unnatural); Felix says Mason 'took the winter', snow gone in the valley
sessions.hint: Immediately after the mushroom-land fight; ruins 'a day or two old' outside
sessions.since: continuous (after the fight, after ~5 weeks real-time break)

place.t: Mushroom plane, ruins of Skjall, the tavern, the refugee camp

sessions.sum: After a recap, the party receives new items and reunites with BB, who learned from Tautok about the Titans and the Wild Hunt. Back on the surface Felix dies and passes Robin his power, Barzan eats a finger of the Winter Goddess, Leumas pushes the Wild Hunt storm back, and the group walks to the refugee camp where healing has failed and Silk arrives.

sessions.title: Crossroads
sessions.season: unknown (night sky over Aarum, snow in Ophris)
sessions.hint: Day 1 of 7 until the tuning fork (Torren: 'E woche')
sessions.sum: The party weighs options in Eloryn's shell and votes to go to Aarum. They teleport there, check on the brewery, sell the golden R and buy items, meet Torren who promises a tuning fork within a week, then teleport to Ophris where the dwarven king offers them kingship rights and says the tavern people visited 210 years ago.

sessions.title: Behemoth, Leviathan and the Golem
sessions.hint: Day 2 of 7 until the tuning fork (est.); evening in Ophris, midday teleport to desert, sunset in Kasta
sessions.sum: In Ophris the party reads two books from Ephraim's dungeon, then teleports into the Kasta desert. They fight a Sentinel, a spider and a snake in forgotten-war ruins, escape a glass field and homunculi, and reach Kasta at sunset, where Sujo hosts them and suggests ways to win the city's trust.

sessions.title: The currency of class
sessions.hint: Day 3 and morning of day 4 in Kasta (est.); Genasi time flows differently

place.t: Kasta (Sujo's garden house, Genasi market, Conjuration tower)

sessions.sum: After a Legend Lore vision of Anubis being sealed, the party shops and dresses up, learns about the seven mage schools and the 500k tomb quest, and spends a day and evening with the Genasi who live in a different time flow. The next morning they receive a star chart and sextant and visit Brel in room 207.

sessions.title: Fussspuren der geheimen Titanen
sessions.hint: Day 4 (est.): morning in Kasta, evening skiff trip into the desert night

place.t: Kasta (library, test centre); desert; underground hole

sessions.sum: Brel tells of Anubis and Kasta's library; the party gets base scores in the Eladrin Library, takes a test to double them, then sails a skiff by Mahdi's star chart into the desert night. They fall into a hole about 2 km deep, find a lightning-glass pyramid and fight a clay golem and its homunculi.

sessions.title: Vier phrasen der geschichte
sessions.hint: Same night as s81 (2 to 3 am at the cocoon rescue), then a long rest and about a day of travel

place.t: Underground hole in the Kasta desert

sessions.sum: After the first golem fight, BB and Eloryn learn golems need life essence. Lorilla scouts and is smashed into glass, the party fights and dispels blood seals until the golem is stopped; after a long rest Lorilla steals a scroll from a homunculi-guarded platform and crashes through the glass floor. The scroll has four phrases and BB remembers the Ziz.

sessions.title: Knoten
sessions.hint: Three-day excursion (est.): day 1 at the hole and city, night in the desert, dawn at the ruins

place.t: Underground hole; Kasta; desert ruins of Ha'roshon Mesugo

sessions.sum: The party solves the scroll's phrase order and a star clue, shrinks the golem into a jar, teleports to Kasta and questions Brel and the Divination rector Teana. Their sending reveals them to Isaak and they flee Kasta, are barred by the city shield, follow the star map to Ha'roshon Mesugo, defeat its guardians and perform a ritual of burning shame notes and washing at sunrise.

sessions.title: chain-links
sessions.hint: Morning of the day after s83 (just after sunrise); continuation of the ritual

place.t: Ruin of the pool at Ha'roshon Mesugo, desert

sessions.sum: At the pool ruin the party compares the blue flowers and stones with Thor's key, learns from obelisk inscriptions and visions about a cycle of pilgrims and a first wizard, tests the ley lines and gets replies by sending from Isaak who gives his name as Abraham.

sessions.title: chain-links
sessions.sum: On the skiff outside Kasta the party learns from Brel and Teana that the city barrier is tied to their blood and that the blood archive lies under the library. Barzan scouts the warded library via the Ethereal Plane, they flee, regroup at Sujo's house, and Snix infiltrates the library tower, finding a steel door before Ed and Og expose his bluff.

sessions.title: chain-links
sessions.sum: In the library the party is forced to read books under threat from the beholders Ed and Og; they kill Og, Barzan dies and is revived, and Ed is knocked down. Each PC then reads visions about Gnolia, archfeys, ley-lines, soul-transfer clones, Anubis and a silence tied to the Leviathan's death, empties the library with a portable hole and returns to the safe house.

place.t: Kasta, then desert gate (Gate to nowhere)

sessions.sum: After a day of research about titans, ley-lines, genasi and a 'gate to nowhere', the party scouts and travels to a huge desert gate guarded by age-altering pyramids and then a many-eyed sphinx-like statue. After an 11-round fight the gate opens onto a fertile valley, 6000 years in the past.

sessions.title: the first big choice
sessions.since: same moment (continuous); about 6000 years before the party's present
sessions.sum: Barzan confirms it is the same mountain 6000 years earlier, the era of the first Earth-breaking. In Gilgamesh's workshop (Gilgamesh is a Sarrukh) the party meets young Jetsi, a succubus and Koda as Dako, who does not recognise them. A fight with Urochar breaks out in which BB is swallowed and revealed as a changeling; Dako and Gilgamesh flee.

sessions.title: nine futures
sessions.since: assumed continuous (the Gilgamesh era, ~6000 years back)
sessions.sum: The party fights the first titan Enoch and kills him; Leumas receives The Fool. They rush through portals and each PC lands in a different place and possibly time (library of a red-stone city, a kobold arena, the Great Hirte's forest, Helikonos, the Feywild, a ship with BB and Wanda/Zima), all bound up with a spreading 'nothing'.

sessions.since: the party members' scenes last weeks; return to the Material Plane ~3 months after the original exit

place.t: Various planes/times, ending in the far north of the Material Plane

sessions.sum: A recap session of the PCs' separate stories: Leumas bargains with a door in the Fey, Lorilla seeks the Great Hirte, BB meets the Gold Daggers of another world, Snix lives among kobolds, Elo is with her younger parents in Helikonos and Barzan builds the ship Calamitas with Bravin. Barzan then rescues everyone, and the group returns to the Material Plane about 3 months after leaving, in a snowstorm and Wild Hunt.

place.t: Forest of the Great Hirte (far north)

sessions.sum: Three months after leaving, the party plans around the Earth-breaker ritual, finds the Great Hirte's warded forest and the dragon-grave obelisk. In the obelisk door visions and wishes each PC is tested; Snix frees the Pandemonium kobolds and Barzan and BB ask the metallic dragons about the Silence. A fight against Tanazir ends with Lorilla returning.

sessions.title: Pfadfindung

place.t: Nyhirtsholm (forest of the Great Hirte), then tavern/Nolia, then Aarum

sessions.sum: Lorilla wakes and heals the party; they loot and identify a cultist as Treth and talk to the Hirte (a faun), set up the tavern, read about Silence, apples and moons. Leumas steps through the tavern into Gnolia where it is stated to be the year 830, BB meets the Summer goddess and takes five apples; the party then teleports to Aarum and rests at the Torren's hotel.

sessions.title: Lured
sessions.sum: In Aarum the party meets Torren, learns about infection and his planned 'planar bomb', visits the tower quarter and its smiths, fights imps; a second portal drops them into Nessus where they pact with demons and kill Moloch.

sessions.title: Eine Frage der Richtigkeit
sessions.since: same day, after the return from Nessus (about 11:30)

place.t: Aarum, Sunken City of Aarum, undercity cathedral

sessions.sum: Back in Aarum from the Nine Hells, the party shops at Abraxas, descends the sewers to the sunken city Ylvar where Ysra lives in ice, buys her item, learns about the first Djinn and takes her aboard, then fights a kraken in the old cathedral of Bragi.

sessions.title: Die vergessene Schwelle
sessions.since: same day (continuous), then four days of downtime

place.t: Aarum (undercity cathedral, tower quarter, Goldie Bräu)

sessions.sum: After the kraken the party loots the cathedral (pope outfits, a darkness bridge, a ritual smoke), returns to Ysra with 'artefacts', visits the smithy and spends four days: forging a Dimensional Knife with Torren, researching, Barzan's meditation and a legend lore vision of Mana and Ephraim, and collecting Abraxas's wares.

sessions.title: Uferlos

place.t: Aarum bay, Avernus, River Styx, Limbo obelisk

sessions.sum: On the Calamitas Ysra explains Stygia, Styx and Limbo; a portal in Ysra's city leads through a blood-ritual circle to Avernus, where the party destroys cult circles, falls into the Styx, is ferried by Charon, crosses a Limbo obelisk built by Mason and ends at the river bank facing a big angry dog.

sessions.title: Der mit der Waage

place.t: River Styx border / gate of the souls

sessions.sum: The Gold Daggers fight Cerberus at the soul gate; during the fight Leumas, Barzan and BB are pulled into visions with Anubis. Afterwards they contact Anubis, loot the site, receive visions of the first obelisk portal and research Levistus.

sessions.title: Unsicher
sessions.hint: Stygia day 1 (visa valid 7 days)
sessions.sum: The party rests, travels down the Styx and enters Stygia with a one-week visa, learns the city's customs at the administration, eats soul fish at EAZA, performs Legend Lore on Levistus and heads for the library the next morning.

sessions.hint: Stygia (visa from S98 valid 7 days)
sessions.sum: More library research in Stygia (elves and the Forgotten War, forgotten species, Felix, god-killings), the ticket rules of the Ball, a follower is caught, then the party rides the lift to Levistus and fights five monsters in his throne room.

sessions.title: Illumination
sessions.sum: Audience with Levistus about earthbreakers, titans and BB's origin; the party leaves with anchor outfits, finds the Leonin Odis Trion in Stygia and is pulled through a portal to Aarum where they kill a tarrasque.

sessions.title: 1-0 Auftakt
sessions.sum: After the tarrasque the party stabilises Aarum, talks with Gilgamesh, wins Frost Giant help for Skjall in a drinking contest, scouts Odis' house in Stygia and ferries reinforcements to Aarum on the eve of the Ball.
The party attends the Planar Ball in costumes, beats Asmodeus in 'Die Wette des Hadeses' to banish six Nothing-infected, but Leumas loses a dance duel against Odyss and is thrown out of the gala.

Leumas re-enters the gala as a servant; the party questions Sani Ambulan and Zariel, learns Odyss was asking about solar eclipses, receives items from Levistus and raids Odyss' villa, capturing four generals and destroying the Hushes.

sessions.hint: ~1.5 months to the eclipse (≈45 days; stated 'ca. eineinhalb mönet')
sessions.sum: The party loots Odyss' villa (Void Shards, Enara, Blast Zepter), researches eclipses in the library (next one in ~1.5 months), returns to Aarum, installs Silk as interim leader and wakes to Zariel's war ship above the city.

sessions.hint: between ~45 days (S104) and 43 days (S108)
sessions.sum: After Zariel's warship, Aarum's harbour is rebuilt, generals are delivered to Ophris and loot sold, then the party kills Odyss in the Astral Sea (Snix takes the Torr armour) and levels up.

sessions.title: 3 legendary items & 3 legendary gspröch
sessions.hint: ~1.5 months (≈45 days) to the eclipse (stated)
sessions.sum: Barzan travels in a vision to Ephraim and is physically pulled to Kasta; the party collects Odyss' loot, finds the Talisman of Ultimate Evil, and resurrects Erkas, returning him to Yorni.

place.t: Lloyd's sanctuary / invisible tower above Kasta

sessions.sum: Barzan asks Ephraim about freeing Anubis; the party visits Ephraim's invisible tower, learns about the Taverne, Mana and Mason, then reads Ephraim's books with costly effects before heading toward the desert storm.

sessions.hint: 43 Tage (countdown to Sonnfinsternis)
sessions.sum: BB and Leumas suffer punishment dreams; the party rides into the Anubis storm, finds the golem Bob with Anubis' pyramid, and with Ephraim jumps to Skjall's past where Tautok shows that the Monument is the failsafe and the borders must move.
